# Installing and removing sesam's git integration only touches sesam's own
# keys; the rest of .git/config (pushurl, repeated keys, comments) survives.

exec git init
exec git config user.email test@sesam.dev
exec git config user.name 'Sesam Test'
exec git remote add origin https://example.com/repo.git
exec git config remote.origin.pushurl ssh://example.com/repo.git
exec git config --add url.https://mirror.example/.insteadOf https://a.example/
exec git config --add url.https://mirror.example/.insteadOf https://b.example/
exec sh -c 'echo "# keep me" >> .git/config'

exec sesam init --user admin --install-merge
exec git config --get-all remote.origin.url
stdout -count=1 '^https:'
exec git config --get-all url.https://mirror.example/.insteadOf
stdout -count=2 '^https:'
grep '# keep me' .git/config
exec git config merge.sesam-merge-secret.driver
stdout 'sesam'

exec sesam uninstall --no-ask
! exec git config merge.sesam-merge-secret.driver
exec git config remote.origin.pushurl
stdout 'ssh://example.com/repo.git'
exec git config --get-all url.https://mirror.example/.insteadOf
stdout -count=2 '^https:'
grep '# keep me' .git/config
